description: Web Soil Survey is the online application of the USDA Natural Resources Conservation Service that serves the Soil Survey Geographic Database (SSURGO), the detailed soil maps and data of the National Cooperative Soil Survey. Users define an area of interest, view and print soil maps with map unit descriptions, explore soil properties and suitability interpretations, such as for building sites, roads, septic systems and crops, through the Soil Data Explorer, build custom reports and download the data. It is produced by NRCS as the single authoritative source of US soil survey information, with soil maps for more than 95 percent of the nation's counties and the aim of complete coverage; version 3.4.0 was current at access. Use is free without registration. Caveats: survey maps are generalised, so NRCS notes that onsite investigation may be needed for engineering projects, and survey dates differ between counties. For simulation it gives soil hydrologic groups, shrink-swell, corrosion, flooding frequency and bearing properties for flood, landslide and ground hazard exposure studies, for pipeline and road planning, and for crop and drought models. It is related to the NCSS Soil Characterization Database record in this catalogue, which holds the laboratory measurements behind the surveys.
